verdict.rationale: Circle publishes an API reference section and per-product OpenAPI specs (Compliance, Gateway, CCTP, Wallets, StableFX, CPN and others), so a first-party, machine-readable API reference exists. Nothing in the evidence shows that it is interactive or that its examples can be run in the browser, and the generic root OpenAPI paths return 404. Missing for 10: evidence of an interactive try-it/explorer UI, runnable request examples, sandbox execution from the docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
